compatibility_decisions: A semantic content heading inside ActivityFeed is compatible with one compact screen navigation header. The #1235 structural test now forbids a second Appbar.Header or large headlineSmall screen title, while allowing the smaller titleMedium empty-state heading required by existing accessibility flows.
The #1182 naturally measured Agents headlineSmall structure is retained exactly; no fixed-height Appbar.Header was introduced.
No existing spec is fundamentally incompatible with #1235. Files Changed and Session remain visible in the compact header, while Manage intentionally requires opening the overflow menu.

The custom Pressables preserve VoiceOver button semantics and 44-point touch targets while avoiding React Native Web's duplicated accessibilityLabel propagation through Paper icon-button wrapper layers.
